en.title: Why AI Agents Still Can't Automate Excel
en.hook: Analyze the practical hurdles AI agents face when attempting complex spreadsheet automation.
key_takeaways: Complexity of spreadsheet structures and context understanding limitations
Difficulty for agents in detecting and fixing formula/data errors
Future improvements needed for reliable business automation
